summary: The document describes a chromium-catalyzed pinacol-type cross-coupling reaction between alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl compounds and aldehydes. It includes optimization tables for solvents and catalysts, mechanistic schemes, and characterization data for several pinacol and cyclopropanol products.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Chromium-catalyzed pinacol cross-coupling reaction: a) 2.0 equiv TMSCl, 2.0 equiv Mn, 0.1 equiv CrCl2, DMF; b) 2.0 equiv TBAF, THF.
items.description: General reaction scheme for the chromium-catalyzed cross-coupling of acroleins and aldehydes to form 1,2-diols.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Postulated mechanism of the Cr II -catalyzed pinacol cross-coupling reaction. R 1 = R 2 = alkyl.
items.description: Proposed catalytic cycle involving chromium allyl species and nucleophilic attack on aldehydes.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Chromium-catalyzed coupling reactions of acroleins with aliphatic aldehydes.
items.description: Table showing the scope of the reaction with various R1 and R2 substituents, listing yields and diastereomeric ratios.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Different transition states resulting from ( Z )- or ( E )-chromium allyl species. TMS = trimethylsilyl.
items.description: Transition state models explaining the formation of syn and anti pinacols from Z and E chromium allyl intermediates.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Skew-boat-like transitions states with pivalaldehyde, analogous to Nozakis and Hiyamas, described in the literature. [17]
items.description: Alternative skew-boat transition state models for sterically demanding substrates like pivalaldehyde.

items.heading: Table 2

items.description: Solvent screening results for the cross-coupling reaction, comparing DMF, THF, and other polar aprotic solvents.

items.heading: Table 3
items.caption: Chromocene derivatives as catalysts: formation of cyclopropanols. [a]
items.description: Results using chromocene catalysts, highlighting the unexpected formation of cyclopropanols in THF.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Postulated catalytic cycle for the formation of cyclopropanols.
items.description: Mechanistic proposal for the catalytic formation of cyclopropanols when silylation is slow.

items.caption: Schiff-base chromium complexes as catalysts.
items.description: Evaluation of chiral Schiff-base ligands for enantioselective pinacol coupling.
